clientOperations.lead: Your entire client workflow. One organized workspace.
clientOperations.headline: Why choose Client Operations
clientOperations.closing: Less administration. More control over your office.

benefits.1: Client information and important records in one place.
benefits.2: Keep upcoming reporting obligations and office tasks visible.
benefits.3: Spend less time switching between spreadsheets and systems.
benefits.4: Identify clients and tasks that need attention.
benefits.5: Organize client-related work across your team.

docflow.lead: Send office documents and keep delivery conversations in one place.
docflow.headline: Why choose DocFlow
docflow.closing: Clearer document delivery. Fewer lost conversations.

benefits.1: Invite clients to receive documents securely.
benefits.2: Keep delivery attempts and message history together.
benefits.3: Open the client conversation from the office workspace.
benefits.4: Separate document delivery from accounting and workflow truth.

invoice.lead: Prepare and issue income documents from an authorized office workspace.
invoice.headline: Why choose Income documents
invoice.closing: Issue documents in the office. Accounting remains the financial source of truth.

benefits.1: Create and review income documents for your clients.
benefits.2: Keep client document work in one authorized workspace.
benefits.3: Use the existing office document types your organization already has.
benefits.4: Leave balances and tax totals to Accounting Base.

fallback.lead: Use this authorized module in its own office workspace.
fallback.headline: What this module offers
fallback.closing: Open it when your office is entitled and the module is active.

benefits.1: Its name, plans, and status come from your office catalog.
benefits.2: Available actions stay limited to what your entitlement allows.
benefits.3: Paid checkout stays unavailable until a payment provider is connected.
